description.text: : an empty, polished showroom floor stretches into dimness, with distant walls and ceiling lost in low light. No other vehicles, displays, or people interrupt the open floor. Deep at the back,

rests in near-darkness, its body almost indistinguishable from the surrounding shadow. The floor catches only faint, cool reflections, tracing the hood and front fenders without fully revealing them. Overhead fixtures stay dim, leaving broad areas of the hall in charcoal gray. At first the vehicle is still, then it eases forward with a slow, deliberate motion. Its silhouette separates gradually from the black background, the nose advancing toward the foreground while the rest of the body remains heavy and dark. Small shifts in the floor reflections suggest the tires beginning to roll, and the shape grows slightly larger and clearer as it leaves the deepest pocket of shadow. The surrounding showroom stays vast and quiet, keeping the car isolated in the frame. A low room tone presses against the silence, and a soft motor hum starts far back in the space, barely rising above the ambient hush.
